d:
Sena nayak filipas se milne ki hath par ara hai aur jab vo milta hai to sabhi bhartiy sainik vidroh kar dete hain, jisse yavnon ke kheme men harkamp mach jata hai, magar is yuddh men us sainik ki mrityu ho jati jo kabhi yavnon ki sena men rah bhartiyon ke viruddh larta tha.aage kya hota hai dekhie is bhag men.
The army leader is adamant about meeting Philipus and when he meets him, all the Indian soldiers revolt, which creates panic in the Yavana camp, but in this war, the soldier who was once in the Yavana army dies. He used to fight against Indians. Watch what happens next in this part.
